PLAN "Pregnancy Strength Maintenance (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength during pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (Weeks 1-4):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 2x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          sumo_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
